teamHint: Your direct reports' days-off requests — accept or reject the pending ones — and their yearly budgets.
loadListError: Could not load the days-off requests
acceptAria: Accept the days-off request of {{name}} starting {{date}}
rejectAria: Reject the days-off request of {{name}} starting {{date}}
moreActionsAria: More actions for the days-off request of {{name}} starting {{date}}
cancelReasonPlaceholder: Why is this request being cancelled?
rejectMessage: The requester will be notified. A rejected request is final — they can submit a new one for the same days.
cancelMessage: Both sides will be notified and any reserved days return to the budget. A reason is required. Cancelling is final.

error.invalidTransition: This request has changed in the meantime — refresh and try again.
error.actionPermission: You are not allowed to do that.
error.actionFailed: The action failed. Please try again.
error.overlap: The period overlaps one of your pending or accepted requests.
error.overBudget: The request does not fit your remaining paid-days budget.
error.overlapOnBehalf: The period overlaps one of this person's pending or accepted requests.
error.overBudgetOnBehalf: The entry does not fit this person's remaining paid-days budget.
error.invalid: The request is invalid — check the dates.

createHint: One request covers one consecutive period within a single calendar year. Weekends and public holidays don't count against your budget; the first and last day can be half days.
recordHint: Record a days-off entry on behalf of someone you manage — directly or anywhere down your management chain — for example to backfill vacation history. The entry is created already accepted, with you as the approver; both of you are notified.
startHalfLabel: First day is a half day
endHalfLabel: Last day is a half day

validation.order: The start date must not be after the end date.
validation.sameYear: A request must not span calendar years — split it into two requests.
validation.zeroCost: The period contains no working days — only weekends or public holidays.

calendar.empty: Nobody to show — you are not a member of any team.

budget.title: Your paid days off in {{year}}
budget.noAllowance: No allowance is configured for your default paid pool yet — ask your manager; requests in it are blocked until then.
budget.noAllowanceOnBehalf: No allowance is configured for this person's default paid pool yet — set it on their days-off page; entries in it are blocked until then.
budget.notAReport: This person is not among the people you manage (anymore) — the budget is not available.
budget.allowanceHint: Whole days; unused days of this pool carry over to the next year. The current value applies to every calendar year — changing it recomputes past balances. The default pool cannot be cleared; extra pools can be archived.
budget.allowanceHintNoCarry: Whole days; this pool resets every January — nothing carries over. The current value applies to every calendar year. Extra pools can be archived.
budget.allowancePermission: You may not change this person's allowance.
budget.allowanceFailed: Could not save the allowance — check your connection and try again.

pool.label: Pool
pool.addHint: Grant this person one of the organization's paid pools with its own yearly allowance. Each request draws on exactly one pool.
pool.noKindsLeft: Every pool kind is already granted.
pool.archivePoolMessage: {{name}} will no longer be able to request days from "{{pool}}". Past requests stay counted. You can grant the pool again later.
pool.typesHint: The organization's kinds of paid days off. Every user has the default pool; managers grant the other kinds to their reports with a yearly allowance. Mark whether unused days carry over to the next year or the pool resets every January.
pool.typesHintReadOnly: The organization's kinds of paid days off. Every user has the default pool; your manager may grant you the other kinds with a yearly allowance.
pool.loadError: Could not load the pool kinds
pool.invalid: The pool is invalid — check the name.
pool.duplicateName: A pool kind with that name already exists.
pool.name: Pool name
pool.carriesOver: Unused days carry over to the next year
pool.carriesOverHint: Unchecked: the pool resets every January. Changing it recomputes every affected budget.
pool.archiveTypeMessage: "{{name}}" will be archived for everyone: nobody can request days from it anymore and every user's grant of it is archived. Past requests stay counted under its name.

holidays.title: Public holidays
holidays.hint: On these dates everyone is off and nothing is deducted from paid-days budgets. Costs of already-submitted requests never change.
holidays.hintReadOnly: On these dates everyone is off and nothing is deducted from paid-days budgets. The list is maintained by administrators.
holidays.empty: No public holidays yet — add the first one above.
holidays.emptyReadOnly: No public holidays have been configured yet.
holidays.loadError: Could not load the public holidays
holidays.name: Name
holidays.duplicateDate: A holiday already exists on this date.
holidays.invalid: The holiday is invalid — check the date and the name.
holidays.deleteMessage: The date becomes a regular working day for future requests; already-submitted requests keep their recorded cost.

auditHint: The HR audit view: every days-off request of {{who}}, at every status. Access is recorded in the audit trail.

corrections.title: Corrections
corrections.hint: Manual ± adjustments to the paid-days budget of a chosen year — they apply immediately and carry over like any unused days. The comment explains why.
corrections.hintReadOnly: Manual ± adjustments your managers made to your paid-days budget. They apply immediately and carry over like any unused days.
corrections.invalid: The correction is invalid — check the amount and the comment.
corrections.commentHint: The reason of the correction — required.
corrections.deleteMessage: The days return to (or leave) the budget immediately. Deleting is final.

managedHint: The requests of {{who}} — accept or reject the pending ones — plus their yearly budget and corrections.
